contract: README.md: larger procedural chess scene, actual knight hop and camera arc, compact hero and immediate tournament access, static opening fallback and local failure handling.

accessibility.evidence: Artwork adds no focus targets. Tab reaches Meet the Trust with a 3px outline. Mobile menu Escape restores focus and clears scroll lock. Copy/actions stay readable through motion. Eligibility unit tests cover reduced motion and data restrictions; actual preference switches are explicitly pending.

responsive.evidence: Desktop peak and resting knight clear the navbar and actions within the compact hero. Tablet/phone remove the scene and smoothing; client/scroll widths match at 819/819 and 375/375. Fresh production phone is at hero top zero. No extra artwork row or page length.

loading.evidence: Recorded reload progresses from static through loading to ready while the opening image and HTML remain available. The valid full scene precedes the 450ms handoff and one-time move.

empty.reason: Bundled public decorative artwork has no empty user collection; missing geometry is an enhancement failure.

error.evidence: Local model HTTP 404 / fallback HTTP 200 leaves loaded opening image and actions, zero canvases and no Lenis. Restored model before build.

partial.evidence: Static and failure paths retain complete copy, both links, navigation and opening artwork without a live scene.

success.evidence: The recording and diagnostics show a 0.32-unit knight hop, landing, camera arc and stable idle frame count. Scroll/reverse, responsive teardown and production navigation succeed.

permission.reason: Public decorative geometry requests no account or device permission. Existing CC BY attribution remains; additional geometry is procedural.

renderedEvidence.observation: Final four-piece arrangement on a larger angled board within the original hero height.
Actual mid-hop frame; knight remains below the floating navbar.
Actual reload/handoff/move/camera arc, captured as a timestamped browser screenshot sequence; not a frame-rate trace.
Keyboard focus on Meet the Trust, outside decorative artwork.
Static opening composition after live desktop teardown; no canvas or smoothing.
Fresh production phone crop with static knight/board behind readable copy and actions.
Production one ready canvas and full scene, without temporary diagnostics.
Unavailable model keeps matching opening image and full actions.
